title: 国产最强公路外胎推荐
notes: Owner post (2025-04-26): ARISUN 风R1 clincher 28C measured 221 g and 风R tubeless 28C measured 269 g. Comments include one owner who said it matched the GP5000 and was better in the wet but wore quickly, and others who said it was very slippery when wet; wear and puncture resistance were the repeated weaknesses.
